meta.title: Optimize reflection
meta.body_summary: Optimize reflection by introducing caching for type/property lookups and compiling expression-based setters/delegates in ChangePropertyAction and CallMethodAction.

perf_labels.notes: OpenAI_Codex optimized reflection with caching and compiled delegates; bot reviews flagged null caching and test gaps; author closed PR after applying suggestions, with tests failing due to missing dotnet.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 170 changed lines, this is a small edit focused on two core files. As a micro-optimization PR it fits small-step performance changes; the closure without merge despite low risk and bot-only review suggests that missing benchmarks and test failures prevented acceptance.

review_details.concern_detail: Copilot bot flagged that caching null results in type cache could prevent later type discovery, missing guard for null setter method causing exceptions, and noted missing XML doc for CreateSetter.
review_details.performance_claim: Reduce reflection overhead by caching type and property lookups, and using compiled expression-based setters and method delegates instead of GetRuntimeProperty, SetValue, and MethodInfo.Invoke.
review_details.rejection_signals: PR closed by author without merge; bot reviews non-blocking; no human feedback; test environment failure prevented performance validation.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Low-level .NET reflection optimization without benchmarks; bot-flagged correctness issues; author closed PR after applying suggestions due to missing performance proof and test environment issues.

detection_detail.code_reading: Copilot bot reviewed code and flagged null-caching, setter guard, and XML doc issues via inline comments.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmarks or measurements; testing command in PR body failed with missing dotnet; no performance validation possible.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: Author closed PR after applying some bot suggestions, but did not pursue further; no fix-in-pr cycle for performance concerns.

core_change_summary.description: In ChangePropertyAction.cs, added static ConcurrentDictionary caches for types and property setters, replaced reflection-based property setting with compiled expression setters. In CallMethodAction.cs, replaced MethodInfo.Invoke with compiled delegate invocation.
change_trajectory: Initial commit added caching and expression compilation for both actions.
Applied Copilot suggestions: added return for type cache, guard for null setter, and XML doc comments.
Author closed PR without merge after last commit.

review_signals.summary: Caching null results in type cache may prevent later type discovery; add return of cached value.
review_signals.action_taken: Author committed fix adding return statement.

review_signals.summary: If propertyInfo.SetMethod is null, CreateSetter throws; add guard to avoid exception.
review_signals.action_taken: Author added guard in a subsequent commit.

review_signals.summary: Add XML doc comment for CreateSetter method explaining its behavior.
review_signals.action_taken: Author added XML doc in commit 82180a2.

review_signals.summary: Bot provided PR overview and flagged issues; no blocking CHANGES_REQUESTED.

collaboration_trajectory: Author opened PR with initial reflection optimization commit.
Within ~20h, Copilot bot reviewed and left 3 inline suggestions.
Author applied all three suggestions in subsequent commits over the next day.
Second bot review at ~36h saw no new issues.
Author closed PR shortly after, without merge, likely due to missing benchmarks and test environment failure.
